paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 7.12, with a change of 21.09% compared to the prior close and 12.84% over a window of 22 sessions. The company has seen 9 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include Fermi's agreement with Hillcore to add 2.6 GW power capacity at a Texas AI campus, as well as the company finally securing a tenant for its Project Matador campus. Construction is also underway at the campus. There have been multiple articles discussing the company's stock movement and a large options volume.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including the appointment of new officers and the issuance of $431.25 million in convertible senior notes. A director, Miles Everson, resigned due to a disagreement over access to company books and records. There has been one Form 4 filing and 16 proxy solicitation filings.
